text: 1 Aged under 40 2.Be in good health condition 3.Applicant should hold Bachelor's degree Admission comes after examination of those files by tutors and SIE and university. An examination follows after one year study in degree program. Failure in this examination will rob the candidates of their chance to do graduation papers and render them into trainees, who are allowed to continue their study, or render them a completion of schooling.
